[[Droknar's Maul]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] obtained from the [[Warrior's Chest]] at the [[Epilogue]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:Health +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same model as the [[Starter Hammer|Starter]] / [[Break Hammer|Break]] / [[Dwarven Hammer|Dwarven]] / [[War Hammer (dwarven)|War]] Hammers, but has a unique texture and it's bigger.
